summary: Read all 12 chapters of the source novel directly (novel/Alices_Adventures_in_Wonderland_English.md) plus story/events.json, story/chapter_manifest.json and the bible/culture.json skeleton, and wrote 44 sourced culture entries covering etiquette (10), dress_code (3), game (4), festival (2), food_dining (6), education (7), language (3) and verse_song (9). All entries carry a chNNN source citation with a verbatim quote; 3 are additionally marked inferred:true with a reason (external/decoded facts not stated verbatim in the source). No UNKNOWN/TBD/empty placeholders used.

inferred_entries.name: Treacle as everyday/medicinal staple food
inferred_entries.reason: grounds the Dormouse's 'treacle-well' joke in the real Victorian food staple and the real Binsey holy well near Oxford, external facts not stated in-text

inferred_entries.name: The Mock Turtle's school curriculum
inferred_entries.reason: the literal wordplay curriculum is fully sourced; the claim that each pun stands for a specific real school subject (Reading/Writing, the four arithmetic operations, History/Geography, Drawing/Sketching/oil-painting, Latin/Greek) is the standard plain-sense decoding, not stated outright in the text

inferred_entries.name: Recitation of moral verse: "How doth the little busy bee"
inferred_entries.reason: identifies the garbled in-story poem as a parody of Isaac Watts's real didactic poem 'Against Idleness and Mischief', an external literary fact not named in the source text

cross_domain_assumptions.one_line: Wonderland customs are written as Alice's real Victorian social world (garden-party croquet, perpetual tea, courtroom procedure, schoolroom curriculum, nursery verse) seen through a drowsy child's imaginative recasting of real people/pets/tradesmen/playing cards as talking figures; almost no custom needed fantastical rewriting since the source already satirises real Victorian practice. Final SUP-* ruling owned by magic-cultivation + world, confirmed at H1.

cross_domain_assumptions.aspect: 'Off with her head!' threats never carried out (ev0041 Gryphon reveal)
cross_domain_assumptions.one_line: Treated as already-realistic in the source itself: a theatrical, habitually empty threat from a hot-tempered aristocrat, never executed on-page. No SUP- reinterpretation needed for this element; politics.json may want a matching LAW-*/OFF-* entry for the legal mechanism, which culture.json does not own.

dependencies_not_yet_available.note: geography.json, characters/index.json and politics.json were all still skeleton_empty at write time (parallel Phase 2 run), so bible/WRITE_RULES.md's LOC-* namespace (not forward-reference whitelisted) is left as empty arrays in every entry's 'locations' field to avoid unresolved cross-refs; location context is instead given in each entry's free-text summary/visual. CHAR-* references (whitelisted for forward reference) use predictable slug-cased character names (e.g. CHAR-hatter, CHAR-queen-of-hearts, CHAR-mock-turtle) for memory-bible/character-manager to reconcile at merge.
dependencies_not_yet_available.expects_reconciliation_by: 00-orchestration/memory-bible at p2-merge, in coordination with 02-worldbuilding/geography and 03-characters/character-manager

The legal mechanism behind 'Off with her head!' (who may issue/stay a sentence) is flagged to 02-worldbuilding/political as a possible LAW-*/OFF-* entry; culture.json only records the social-etiquette layer (CUL-ASM-02).
